notes:
Background:
- Mid-market B2B product analytics platform (customer-facing product assistant + in-app search).
- Came in via PLG funnel; wanted quick hosted API integration to validate UX.

Hosted API trial (3 weeks):
- Trial start: 2024-11-15; Demo + walkthrough 2024-11-29 (ff recording: ff_2024-11-29_zfold_demo_4531).
- Primary traffic: chat assistant (65%), embedding-based doc-search (25%), reranking for recommendations (10%).
- Observed traffic: steady-state QPS 6-12, stress test peak QPS 35 (6-min window during release test).
- Average tokens per request: ~590 (prompt ~450, gen ~140). Token distribution: ~60% short (<128), ~30% medium (128-1024), ~10% long (>1024).
- Latency: mean server-side token generation ~220ms per 64-token block; end-to-end median response time ~420ms on hosted API.
- Cost sensitivity: product team targeting unit economics that keep inference cost < 15% of gross margin; asked for guidance to hit <$0.0009 per token-equivalent.

POC / Evaluation asks (Dedicated focus):
- Need Dedicated sizing and traffic forecasting after seeing Hosted behavior. Key asks in workshop 2024-12-18:
  * Sustained target QPS: 25 (US + EU combined) with spikes to 80 QPS for planned campaigns.
  * Concurrency headroom: require 200+ concurrent in-flight requests (client-side concurrency peaks observed ~160 in spike test).
  * Latency SLOs: 95th < 750ms, 99th < 1.5s for primary chat flows.
  * Daily token volume (baseline): ~75M tokens/day; expected 2.5x growth over 6 months.
  * Model mix preference: prefer open Llama-derivative for cost profile, but want Redwood-verified profile and fallback to a smaller model for low-cost routing.
  * Feature needs: prefix/KV caching, autoscaling burst capacity, per-route throttling, VPC peering, KMS integration, audit logs retained 1y for compliance.

Sizing worksheet (shared 2024-12-20):
- Preliminary recommendation: 4 x high-memory GPU nodes (dedicated pool) sized to sustain ~30-40 sustained QPS with caching and batching; additional 2x burst nodes for campaign peaks.
- Expected token throughput: ~75M tokens/day => peak hourly tokens ~15M (during campaign windows).
- Fallback policy: route low-cost requests to quantized variants; auto-fallback to hosted pool in cross-region outage.
- Cost estimate (model-dependent): projected monthly inference spend $8k-$18k on Dedicated infra + license/ops; compares favorably to hosted at current trial spend.

Customer feedback / quotes:
- "Hosted API integration was fast; we saw the UX improvement immediately, but predictability is the blocker for scaling." — Head of Product (A. Guerrero)
- "We need firm guidance on GPUs + headroom. If we underprovision we'll miss SLAs during campaigns." — Eng. lead (S. Patel)

Recent timeline (selected):

- 2025-01-10: Procurement kickoff with legal and infra (budget comms started).
